title: Hex8 reduced integration (1-point quadrature)
objective: Add a 1-point integration variant of Hex8 alongside the existing 2x2x2 full-integration Hex8. Introduces the concept of an integration rule distinct from the element topology.

plan_assets.asset_description: B5.1 Hex8 reduced with 1-point quadrature and hourglass control.

scope: Introduce an `IntegrationRule` enum or string parameter: `FULL` (2x2x2, default), `REDUCED` (1-point).
Add a hex8_reduced_tables.py with the 1-point Gauss rule (center point, weight = 8 for unit cube).
Wire the integration rule through Element IR so the generator can pick the right tables.
Note: reduced integration produces hourglass modes; P5-5 adds the control. This task only adds the reduced integration itself — without hourglass control, the element is unstable on its own.
implementation_steps: Define the IntegrationRule enum or parameter.
Extend Element IR's Hex8 basis construction to accept the integration rule.
Unit-test: under constant strain, reduced Hex8 produces the same stress as full Hex8 (the reduced rule integrates linear functions exactly).
acceptance_criteria: Constant-strain test: reduced and full Hex8 produce identical stress.
Non-constant strain: reduced Hex8 produces different (and without hourglass control, wrong) stress — documented as expected.
IntegrationRule enum round-trips through the IR.
risks: Without hourglass control (P5-5), reduced Hex8 is unusable in practice. Document in the docstring that the user must set `hourglass='flanagan_belytschko'` before using reduced integration.
completion_notes: Added IntegrationRule enum (FULL, REDUCED) in mechanics_ir.py.
Added hex8_reduced_tables.py (1-pt Gauss at center, weight 8.0); re-exports shape functions from hex8_tables.
Added integration_rule field to ElementIR as trailing keyword-default (no callsite breakage).
REDUCED rule rejected on non-hex8 topologies with Plan B phase B5 pointer.
Full fast suite: 1178 passed + 20 skipped + 1 expected TODO fail (delta +3/-3 vs post-P5-3).
